obvious_hallucination.reason: The claimed AUROC values at τ=0.2 directly conflict with repository output files. The paper_integration_summary.md (the document used to write the paper) explicitly shows: Llama SE tau_0.2 AUROC = 0.672 (not 0.620); Qwen SE tau_0.2 AUROC = 0.529 (not 0.635). The CI values [0.534, 0.706] and [0.537, 0.733] also do not match any DeLong CIs in the data (both distributions are degenerate for tau=0.2 in multiple files). The discrepancy is too large (Qwen: 20% off) to be explained by stochastic variation.
